videos.author: gary.krivokapich
videos.caption: REAL AI BLOOPERS! REAL AI BLOOPERS! 😂🤖 You thought AI was easy? Just tell it what to do and—BAM—you've got a video! HELL NO! 😂 AI got stuck on this one and cost me about a couple of hours. And remember, my finished animations may only be around 3 minutes long, but they can take me 4 to 6 hours to complete. Here’s the truth about making these things: Sometimes I screw up. Sometimes AI screws up. Sometimes AI seems to wake up IN A BAD MOOD! And sometimes it's apparently so damn busy it just kicks me out! And when that happens, some of the stuff AI puts out—or WE put out together—is downright hilarious. So instead of throwing all these mistakes away, I figured: LET'S HAVE SOME FUN WITH THEM! But underneath all the craziness, I still believe AI can be an incredible tool. You know what? It's fun to support democracy—with AI!And fight... well, YOU KNOW WHO! 😂 Now don't beat me up too bad. I've also said AI needs some control like we control Nuclear Energy.  We need to deal with its enormous energy demands, and we especially need American AI for our national defense and competition with Russia and China. And yeah—we probably ought to make damn sure it doesn't take all our jobs... or just plain kill us! 😂 AI can be brilliant. AI can be stupid. AI can be hilarious. And apparently AI CAN HAVE A BAD DAY! Welcome to the blooper reel. And if you haven't seen them yet, GO WATCH MY LARRY & BRENDA VIDEOS! Those two Oklahoma farmers have survived politics, voter rolls, tornadoes, hailstorms—and me fighting with AI to make the damn cartoons. 😂 NO CIVIL WAR. Let's laugh at ourselves once in a while.
